LESSON: WATER ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and
Topic 1.2: Water its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Water its resources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. make water clean and safe using different methods
2. construct a simple water filter for cleaning water at home
3. appreciate clean and safe water for use to reduce health risks. materials water to make it clean and safe for use. Core-competence to be developed: Critical thinking and problem solving, communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity. Links to PCI’s: ESD-Environmental Education: Environment and water, Effective communication: learners name methods of making water clean and safe for use Links to other learning activity areas (s): Hygiene and Nutrition, Movement and Creative art; Literacy for use.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. make water clean and safe using different methods
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make water clean and safe using different methods. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. construct a simple water filter for cleaning water at home
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to construct a simple water filter for cleaning water at home. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate clean and safe water for use to reduce health risks. materials water to make it clean and safe for use. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Water its resources.
2. Explain Water its resources to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Water its resources.
4. Show that you can: make water clean and safe using different methods
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Water its resources. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Water its resources important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. make water clean and safe using different methods
2. construct a simple water filter for cleaning water at home
3. appreciate clean and safe water for use to reduce health risks. materials water to make it clean and safe for use.
